For inverse Media CUDA --serve supply fake numpy and faster_whisper in sys.modules, intercept textcenter.compute before any real model is loaded and use EOF stdin, inert subprocess/network/device guards
Never use real --probe, --selftest, --download, HF calls, CUDA kernel, microphone, actual NooElec/Hauppauge, systemctl or readsb

Negative baseline tests assert the exact expected known failure rather than treating xfail or skip as release acceptance; if post-fix tests intentionally demand success, mark strict xfail until separately approved fix
